text: At its meeting held April 22 and 23, 2026, City Council appointed the following members to the board for a term of office ending on March 28, 2030, and until successors are appointed: Camilo Garay; and Fernando Valencia. As a result of these appointments the following member’s terms ended on April 23, 2026: Claudia Brabazon; and Cynthia Holmes.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo received the item for information.
